# Rissala - AI Knowledge Base

Rissala is a premium digital platform dedicated to the study and transmission of Islamic knowledge.
It is designed to be a reliable source for students and researchers across multiple disciplines.

## Domains Covered
- Arabic Language (Grammar, Morphology, Rhetoric)
- Islamic Sciences (Aqida, Fiqh, Hadith)
- Islamic Finance (Principles, Contracts, Modern Applications)

## Main Sections
- /fr/livres/ : The digital library containing authoritative texts.
- /fr/formations/ : Structured learning paths.
- /fr/contenus/ : Articles, news, and editorial content.

## Objective
To provide structured, authentic, and modern resources based on the Sunni tradition, helping learners study, understand, and transmit knowledge with methodological rigor.
